sources.entry: cc-costline by Ventuss-OvO - Enhanced statusline for Claude Code — see your 7d/30d spend at a glance

summary.one_liner: cc-costline is an npm-installed enhanced statusline for Claude Code that shows session tokens, cost, context usage, 5h/7d usage limits, rolling 7d/30d spend, and an optional ccclub leaderboard rank.
summary.what_it_does: It installs a custom statusline into Claude Code via a global npm package and an install command. The statusline displays session token count, session cost, context-window percentage, and the active model name. It also shows Claude 5-hour and 7-day utilization, colored like the context indicator, and switches to a countdown when a limit reaches 100%. A rolling period-cost segment shows 7d, 30d, or both, and an optional segment shows the ccclub leaderboard rank and cost when ccclub is installed. Cost is computed from a per-model price table (per million tokens) that separates input, output, cache write (5-minute and 1-hour TTL), and cache read rates, with a fast-mode multiplier for Opus 5 and 4.8. Unknown models fall back by family name, defaulting to Sonnet pricing.
use_cases: see Claude Code session cost in the terminal
view context window usage while coding with Claude Code
compare spend on a leaderboard with friends via ccclub
notable: Cache writes priced by TTL: 5-minute at 1.25x input, 1-hour at 2x input, read from the transcript's cache_creation breakdown
Fast mode (usage.speed fast on Opus 5 / 4.8) billed at 2x the standard rate
Usage-limit segments auto-color like context and show a countdown at 100%
caveats: npm does not auto-update the global package; updates must be run manually
Sonnet 5 cost reads slightly high until introductory pricing ends on 2026-08-31, since the table uses standard $3/$15 pricing
keywords: see how much claude code costs
